purpose: Explain the frozen 219 validation cases without training, test access or deployment changes
acceptance: Retain both pilot resolutions and all original completeness/resolution limits. Check all eight scores and each misclassified predicted-minus-true margin. Check global criteria separately for core and supplement. Withhold an entire stratum's descriptive rankings if its QA fails; never silently drop failed cases. Publish every failure and its validation row identifier.
summary_rule: Use 128-point contributions. Report core own-true-class score importance over all eight cases per class, including mistakes, and a balanced 64-case summary. Report error margins separately by true/predicted pair and stratum. Positive margin attribution favors the predicted class relative to the true class versus this background. Supplement is purposefully selected, not prevalence representative; it also contains correct detections selected by the original protocol.
seed_comparison: Normalize each model's mean absolute feature vector to sum to one before equally averaging the three centralized or IID seeds. Report all-three top-five intersections and pairwise top-five Jaccard overlap. These are descriptive seed stability, not confidence intervals. Non-IID has one seed only.
stopping_rule: Verify the complete provenance chain, all seven checkpoints, all selected predictions and pilot arrays before integration. Refuse output overwrite. Run only 64 and 128 points per path; no adaptive retries, threshold changes or resampling. Require exact replay of the eight pilot attribution arrays embedded in the full run. Numerical failures end in numerical_review_required, not another experiment.
limits: Background-averaged integrated gradients, not exact conditional Shapley values or causal effects.
Same 128 uniformly sampled training rows: no Web-based or Brute Force background examples.
Correlated and discrete features can make straight interpolation unrealistic.
Eight core examples per class and a selected supplement cannot estimate population feature importance or detector quality.
Previously reused, within-collection validation; no unseen-session or final-test generalization claim.
No device identities, real edge measurements, automatic blocking rules or security-policy validation.
